tools.name: get_progression
tools.description: Read milestone/XP progress, unspent Development Points, purchased node names, and the current Development Tree frontier. The default omits distant locked branches; pass service to inspect one service tree. Use this after a milestone or when an advanced service is locked.

service.description: Optional service name or unambiguous substring, such as Electricity or Water & Sewage, to inspect that service's full development tree

tools.name: purchase_development_node
tools.description: Purchase one eligible Development Tree node by name from get_progression. Uses the game's native DevTreeSystem validation, spends legitimately earned points, emits the normal unlock event and leaves state unchanged when points, service availability or prerequisites are insufficient.

name.description: Development node name from get_progression; an unambiguous substring is accepted

tools.name: demand
tools.description: Residential (low/medium/high density), commercial, industrial, office and storage demand of the loaded city. buildingDemand uses the game's internal 0-255 scale (NOT 0-100); companyDemand counters can exceed 255. Includes the demand factors that explain WHY demand is high or low (e.g. Taxes, Unemployment, EmptyZones, Homelessness). Positive factor values push demand up, negative values push it down.

tools.name: wait_simulation
tools.description: Run the simulation forward by in-game time: default 1 in-game hour (about 20-30 real seconds at the engine 8x speed cap). Resumes if paused, then restores the previous speed/pause state. On success the result includes city overview fields (population, money, xp, happiness, etc.) plus hours/completed/targetReached. Call after zoning or placing buildings so construction and growth can happen; then re-check city_services.problems[]/demand. First turn can wait for the first snapshot. Never poll.

tools.name: debug_zone_blocks
tools.description: DEVELOPMENT/ACCEPTANCE DIAGNOSTIC (use only when asked): dump zone prefab metadata, per-block cell state and VacantLot buffers around x,z.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current game view as a PNG image. Useful for seeing the city layout, checking what the player is looking at, or verifying the result of an action. Returns the image directly.

tools.name: budget
tools.description: Detailed city budget: total income/expenses, balance, and a per-source breakdown (residential/commercial/industrial/office taxes, service fees, subsidies, service upkeep, loan interest, electricity/water import-export, map tile upkeep). Values are monthly rates; expenses are positive costs.

tools.name: city_services
tools.description: Electricity (production/consumption/battery/trade), water & sewage (capacity/consumption/trade), and daily garbage production of the loaded city. Garbage production is not a shortage; use notifications for actual GarbagePilingUp warnings. Compare electricity/water/sewage supply against consumption.

tools.name: labor
tools.description: Employment data: employed citizens, unemployment rate, homelessness, total/free jobs broken down by required education level, and the population age structure (children/teens/adults/seniors).

tools.name: statistics
tools.description: Time series of a city statistic (sampled 32x per in-game day). Useful types: Population, Money, Income, Expense, HouseholdCount, WorkerCount, Unemployed, TouristCount, CrimeRate, BirthRate, DeathRate, CitizensMovedIn, CitizensMovedAway, ResidentialTaxableIncome, TrafficFlow-style passenger counts (PassengerCountBus/Subway/Train...). An invalid type returns the full list of valid names.

samples.description: History samples to return. Default 16, max 64.

tools.name: get_taxes
tools.description: Current tax rate and allowed range for each tax area: Residential, Commercial, Industrial, Office.

tools.name: set_tax
tools.description: Set the tax rate (integer percent) for one tax area. The rate is clamped to the game's allowed range (returned in the response). Higher taxes raise income but lower demand and happiness.

tools.name: policies
tools.description: All city-wide policies with their internal name, localized title, active state, locked state and whether they take a slider adjustment value (e.g. Recycling, Education Subsidies, speed limits).

tools.name: set_policy
tools.description: Activate or deactivate a city-wide policy by its internal name (from policies). Slider policies additionally accept an adjustment value. Locked policies cannot be set.

active.description: true to activate, false to deactivate

tools.name: service_budgets
tools.description: Per-service budget sliders (50-150%, 100 = default) with current efficiency, estimated upkeep cost and building count for every city service (police, healthcare, education, transport, ...).

tools.name: set_service_budget
tools.description: Set the budget percentage (50-150) for one city service by name (from service_budgets). Lower budgets save money but reduce service efficiency; higher budgets do the opposite.

tools.name: list_prefabs
tools.description: Search game prefabs by name and/or typed role. Requires role and/or query. Use role for infrastructure/services; query for name substrings like 'Highway' or 'School'. Check 'locked' for milestone blocks. Default limit 16, max 64.

category.description: Prefab category (default building); 'net' = all networks incl. train tracks, pipes, power lines, pedestrian paths

query.description: Name substring filter. Required if role is omitted.

role.description: Typed capability filter from prefab ECS data. Prefer over name guessing for infrastructure and services. At least one of role or query is required.

tools.name: get_operational_area
tools.description: Inspect building-owned operational polygons such as landfill storage or specialized-industry extraction areas. Returns polygon nodes, surface area, current storage/extraction state and native capacity/resource requirements. Use a building entity from list_buildings. This is read-only.

tools.name: expand_operational_area
tools.description: Expand one owner-linked landfill storage or specialized-industry extractor area to a requested total surface. The tool preserves the locked building edge, plans a near-circle minus obstacles, adds nodes, samples terrain, rejects candidates crossing unowned land, buildings or roads, and commits through the game's native validation/apply pipeline. Extractors rank clear candidates by polygon/resource intersection; fertile land, ore, oil and fish use the natural-resource map while forest scans productive tree entities. Call get_operational_area afterward to verify simulation state.

index.description: Building entity index from list_buildings; use an expandable storage or extractor capability

target_area_m2.description: Requested total polygon surface in square metres; must exceed the current surface

tools.name: list_facility_upgrades
tools.description: List installable and already-installed facility upgrades for one building from list_buildings. Returns prefab names plus installed, enabled and locked state. Read-only; use set_facility_upgrade to install a missing upgrade or toggle Out of Service.

tools.name: set_facility_upgrade
tools.description: Install a missing facility upgrade or toggle Out of Service on an installed one through the native object-upgrade and policy pipelines. upgrade is a prefab name from list_facility_upgrades. enabled=true installs or returns the upgrade to service; enabled=false sets Out of Service. Do not use place_building for upgrades.

upgrade.description: Exact upgrade prefab name from list_facility_upgrades

enabled.description: true installs or returns to service; false sets Out of Service

tools.name: list_transit_stops
tools.description: List existing transit stops (station sub-stops and roadside stops) with type, position and how many lines already use them. Read-only. Use these entity ids with create_transit_line. Do not use place_building to create a stop.

type.description: Optional passenger type filter such as bus, tram, train, subway or ferry

x.description: Optional search center X; with z, keeps the nearest stops inside radius

radius.description: Search radius in meters when x and z are set (default 250)

limit.description: Maximum stops to return. Default 16, max 64.

tools.name: list_transit_lines
tools.description: List transit lines. Optional x/z/radius keeps lines with a stop/waypoint inside the range. Optional type filter. Default limit 16, max 64.

type.description: Optional passenger type filter such as bus, tram, train, subway or ferry

limit.description: Maximum lines to return. Default 16, max 64.

radius.description: Radius in meters (default 250 when center given)

tools.name: create_transit_line
tools.description: Create a simple passenger line through the native route-tool apply pipeline (GenerateRoutesSystem / ApplyRoutesSystem after pathfinding). stops is an ordered list of list_transit_stops ids as index:version,index:version. Default type is bus. The line closes back to the first stop. Vehicles spawn from depots natively. Do not use place_building for stops or lines.

stops.description: Ordered stop list from list_transit_stops: index:version,index:version. At least two stops of the same passenger type.

type.description: Passenger line type; default bus. Must match the stops.

tools.name: delete_transit_line
tools.description: Delete one transit line from list_transit_lines through the same Deleted component the transportation overview uses. Does not demolish stops or stations.

tools.name: place_building
tools.description: ONE-STEP placement: give prefab + x/z. For every agent-chosen site, include radius and omit rotation; the tool generates a bounded internal search, derives shoreline snapping and road frontage from PlacementFlags.Shoreline and BuildingFlags.RequireRoad, preflights the full footprint for owned land, rotated building/road overlap and ordinary ground-water intrusion, ranks valid poses deterministically, then sends only one finalist through the game's real validation and placement pipeline. Omit radius or set rotation only when the player explicitly requires an exact pose. If exact placement fails, retry with a larger radius and no rotation. Off-road utility nodes receive the required pipe/cable connection; road-fronted nodes use the networks carried by the road. Do NOT use this for regular zoned residential/commercial/industrial/office buildings - those grow from zone_area.

radius.description: Nearby search radius in meters. Required for agent-chosen sites; omit only for a player-selected exact pose. Increase it after a failed exact or narrow placement.

rotation.description: Exact Y-axis rotation in degrees. Omit for agent-chosen sites so RequireRoad prefabs face the road and shoreline prefabs derive orientation from the wet/dry boundary.

tools.name: build_road
tools.description: Build a road or utility-network segment between two world coordinates. Use SHORT segments (50-250m) on OWNED map tiles and connect roads near EXISTING road nodes. For ROAD prefabs, omitting mode selects ground: the route is sampled at roughly 4m or finer intervals for water and local grade, rejecting detected water crossings or grades above 10% (or a stricter prefab limit) instead of silently becoming a bridge or tunnel. Use mode=grade-separated only for an intentional bridge, elevated road or tunnel; provide both e1 and e2, with at least one nonzero. Do not pass mode for pipes, cables or other non-road networks. Pipes and Ground Cables remain UNDERGROUND by default (auto -10m buried), so omit e1/e2 to accept that burial. If the call fails, change the route or use shorter segments; do NOT repeat the same coordinates.

prefab.description: Exact prefab name from list_prefabs (category road or net)

cx.description: Curve control point X. Provide together with cz to build a curve through that point; omit both for a straight segment.

cz.description: Curve control point Z. Provide together with cx to build a curve through that point; omit both for a straight segment.

mode.description: Road prefabs only. Omit to select ground, which samples at roughly 4m or finer intervals and rejects detected water crossings or local grades above 10% (or a stricter prefab limit). Use grade-separated only for an intentional bridge/elevated/tunnel segment; provide both e1 and e2, with at least one nonzero. Never pass mode for utility-network prefabs.

e1.description: Elevation at start in meters relative to terrain (-30..60). Required together with e2 for a grade-separated road, where at least one endpoint must be nonzero; positive values are elevated and negative values are underground. Not an entity id. Omit for a ground road or automatic utility burial.

e2.description: Elevation at end in meters relative to terrain (-30..60). Required together with e1 for a grade-separated road, where at least one endpoint must be nonzero. Not an entity id. Omit for a ground road or automatic utility burial.

tools.name: list_buildings
tools.description: Find buildings existing in the city by typed service role, operational-area capability, prefab-name substring, or location. Returns roles, capabilities, world position, current entity id and footprint. Prefer role over guessing internal prefab names; use role=garbage for landfills, role=police for police facilities, and role=specialized-industry with operational_area=extractor for farms/extractors. Entity ids change after save reload. Hard max 128 results.

role.description: Typed role derived from prefab ECS components

operational_area.description: Require an owner-linked operational area of this kind

radius.description: Radius in meters for spatial filter (default 250 with x/z)

tools.name: list_zone_types
tools.description: All zone TYPES (residential low/medium/high, commercial, industrial, office...) with internal name, area type and locked state. Small type list (not painted cells); use count_zone_cells for per-type cell counts. Use the exact name with zone_rectangle or zone_area.

tools.name: zone_area
tools.description: Paint zoning on all zonable cells within a circular radius. Use this for small irregular patches; prefer zone_rectangle along straight road frontage because circles can spill into occupied neighboring blocks. Do NOT use place_building for zoneable buildings. Generic residential/commercial names automatically resolve to the current map theme. Buildings grow while the simulation runs. Default radius 32m. Check demand first.

zone.description: Zone name from list_zone_types, a generic residential/commercial name that will resolve to the map theme, or 'None' to dezone

tools.name: zone_rectangle
tools.description: Paint zoning inside one rotated rectangle. This is the PRIMARY zoning tool for straight road frontage: choose a center, width, depth and rotation that cover fresh zonable strips without touching occupied neighboring blocks. Width follows the rectangle's local X axis; depth follows local Z; rotation is clockwise in world-view degrees. Generic residential/commercial names automatically resolve to the current map theme. Buildings grow while the simulation runs.

zone.description: Zone name from list_zone_types, a generic residential/commercial name that will resolve to the map theme, or 'None' to dezone

width.description: Full rectangle width in meters along its local X axis

depth.description: Full rectangle depth in meters along its local Z axis

tools.name: set_road_features
tools.description: Set composition features on an existing road segment from list_networks: grass, trees, wideSidewalk, soundBarrier, parking, lighting, medianGrass, medianTrees. This uses the game's native road-feature upgrade pipeline but does NOT change road prefab, width or lane layout.

side.description: Which side for side upgrades (default both)

tools.name: replace_road_type
tools.description: DEVELOPMENT/ACCEPTANCE EXPERIMENTAL: replace one simple standalone road edge with a different road prefab through the game's native Replace pipeline. Only road-to-road replacement is supported. v0 rejects intersections, chain segments, owned/fixed edges and locked target prefabs. The original edge entity may change; refresh list_networks after success.

index.description: Road segment entity index from list_networks

version.description: Road segment entity version from list_networks

prefab.description: Exact replacement road prefab from list_prefabs(category=road)

tools.name: list_networks
tools.description: Inventory of typed network edges for one required kind (road, water, sewage, low_voltage). Zero topology: no isolated/kinds/componentSize. Shared fields: entity, prefab, start, end, length; distanceM when x/z given. Road also returns widthM and traffic{volumeIndex, congestionIndex, activeBottlenecks}. Water and sewage are geometry only; low_voltage electricity{flow,capacity,bottleneck} is deferred pending Windows Game.dll. Sort: distance (with x/z); traffic_volume|congestion for road; load for low_voltage once electricity fields land. Default limit 16, max 64. Use inspect_network_topology for isolation QA.

radius.description: Radius in meters for spatial filter (default 250)

sort.description: Optional ranking: distance (needs x/z); traffic_volume or congestion (kind=road only); load (kind=low_voltage, once electricity fields land)

tools.name: inspect_network_topology
tools.description: Topology QA for one required kind. kind=road: near_miss, unnoded_crossing, too_close_junctions, short_stub, isolated_road (optional dead ends with include_dead_ends). kind=water|sewage|low_voltage: only isolated_* components that do not reach a road edge. Findings capped at 64. Optional x/z/radius.

radius.description: Radius in meters for spatial filter (default 500)

include_dead_ends.description: If true, also list degree-1 dead ends as facts, not as QA errors

tools.name: demolish
tools.description: Demolish (bulldoze) one building from list_buildings or one typed-network edge from list_networks (road, water pipe, sewage pipe, or low-voltage cable), identified by entity index and version. Trees, plants, districts, tracks and other nets are unsupported. Irreversible; double-check the target first.

index.description: Entity index from list_buildings or list_networks

version.description: Entity version from list_buildings or list_networks

tools.name: get_camera
tools.description: Current gameplay camera: pivot (look-at point), position, compass/tilt angles and zoom distance.

tools.name: set_camera
tools.description: Point the gameplay camera: set the pivot (look-at world coordinates; height auto-sampled from terrain unless y given), compass rotation angleX (degrees), tilt angleY (0-89) and zoom distance. Combine with screenshot to LOOK at any place in the city 鈥?the AI's own eyes.

y.description: Pivot height (optional, terrain height used if omitted)

tools.name: local_map
tools.description: Budgeted semantic-vector LOCAL_MAP v1 for a map range. Returns a local coordinate frame, elevation/slope/water/owned/buildable summaries, connected regions, road nodes/edges, directional sectors, and omitted metadata. Use before choosing an expansion direction or placing shoreline/terrain-sensitive infrastructure. Coordinates in region and network geometry are quantized units relative to frame.origin_world; multiply by quantum_m to recover meter offsets. Spatial evidence, not native construction validation. Requires x+z+radius or xMin+zMin+xMax+zMax bounds.

radius.description: Half-size of square range in meters (with x+z)

tools.name: probe_cell_layer
tools.description: Compact cell-map probe (landValue, pollution, groundWater, …) for a map range: value min/max/mean plus fixed 8x8 samples. Requires x+z+radius or xMin+zMin+xMax+zMax. If the range covers more than 128 native cells, returns truncated=true with a warning and still only 8x8 samples. Never returns full arrays.

radius.description: Half-size of square range in meters (with x+z)

tools.name: count_zone_cells
tools.description: Aggregated summary of painted zones (counts only, never per-cell rows): cells per zone type with occupied/empty split, whole-city or within an optional x/z/radius. Empty zoned cells are where buildings will grow. Whole-city counts are cheap and safe to call.

tools.name: notifications
tools.description: Citywide warning-icon summary. countsByType and topIssues are always complete citywide. Optional x/z/radius and limit filter detail items only (default limit 16, max 64). Use type as a substring filter. Inspect targets with inspect.

type.description: Notification type name substring filter (case-insensitive, optional)

x.description: Optional center X for detail filtering (requires z)

z.description: Optional center Z for detail filtering (requires x)

radius.description: Detail filter radius in meters (default 250 when center given)

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Detail view of one entity (building/road) by index+version: prefab, position, status flags (abandoned/condemned/destroyed), renters with citizen/employee counts, and for buildings the lot footprint (lotSize in 8m cells / footprintMeters). Like clicking a building in game.

tools.name: get_loan
tools.description: Current loan principal, daily interest rate, daily payment and the city's creditworthiness (max borrowable).

tools.name: set_loan
tools.description: Set the city's loan principal: higher than current = borrow more (cash added to treasury), lower = repay, 0 = repay fully. Clamped to creditworthiness. Interest accrues daily.

tools.name: get_fees
tools.description: Current price the city charges per service (electricity, water, healthcare, education levels, garbage, parking, public transport...) with slider ranges and estimated monthly income per fee.

tools.name: set_fee
tools.description: Set the fee/price for one service resource (name from get_fees). Higher fees raise income but reduce usage and citizen happiness.

fee.description: Fee value; must be within the resource sliderRange from get_fees (rejected if out of range).

tools.name: save_game
tools.description: DEVELOPMENT/ACCEPTANCE: trigger an asynchronous manual save when an acceptance procedure or the player explicitly requires one. Do not use it as an ordinary autonomous safety step. The default name is timestamped 'CS2MCP ...'.

tools.name: list_tiles
tools.description: List map tiles. filter=owned (default) or all (must be explicit); also unowned|available. Not item-capped. Tiles are 623m squares on a 23x23 grid.

tools.name: buy_tiles
tools.description: Purchase one unowned map tile so you can build/zone on it. Give ?index=<entity index> from list_tiles (or ?gridX=&gridZ= grid coordinates). The game validates permits and funds, charges the tile price and unlocks it. Buy tiles ADJACENT to your current city before expanding roads.

index.description: Map tile entity index from list_tiles

gridX.description: Tile grid X (0-22) as reported by list_tiles

gridZ.description: Tile grid Z (0-22) as reported by list_tiles
